equation: integral_T W6(|y-x|,h) sum_a lambda_a(y) f_a dy
algorithm: Six physical edges; shared J interval parity recurrences; two face-specific combined C_m=delta K_m-a^m delta K_0 parity recurrences; regular exterior flux; fused P1 contraction; no quadrature in kernel
complexity: O(6D) work per pair for fixed radial degree D=15; constant local state; O(N+E) global input/output/static geometry storage; zero global per-pair scratch
scope: Isolated 3D straight-tetrahedron W6/P1 scalar prototype, not the full 28 or 2200 outputs, production replacement, or solver coupling

final-cpu-fp64.scope: One scalar integral of W6 times a P1 field, with shared edge J and face-specific combined K recurrences; all per-query work in one kernel
limitations: Prototype, not a production operator replacement
Static normals/tangents/outward vectors/FEM gradients prepared once per tet in host fp64 and stored in the selected device dtype
No quadrature, recurrence DAG interpreter or global per-pair integration scratch
Field, particle, support and tet index are independently supplied per pair
Raw fp32 is diagnostic; accepted analytic-fp64 policy unchanged
Warm times exclude JIT/static geometry and reuse input/output buffers
No search, scatter or global assembly; only a local particle-tet scalar
GPU measurements serialized, clocks/caches and desktop activity uncontrolled

limitations: All performance refers to one scalar, not all coupled operators
fp64 errors meet finite 1e-10 validation budgets, not universal machine-epsilon certification
Raw device fp32 is diagnostic and fails existing 1e-5 budget; no accuracy-equivalent replacement claim
Static geometry prepared in host fp64 then stored in requested dtype; moving mesh preparation not optimized
End-to-end timing includes host input validation, allocation, upload, launch and readback but excludes JIT and separately timed static geometry
FLOPs count measured add/mul/FMA (FMA=2); division/sqrt/log/atan and integer/control costs are not assigned equivalent FLOPs
Canonical profiler counts are branch/workload specific; mixed batch performance is measured separately
Compiler reports a 1024-byte stack reservation; measured local LD/ST sectors and spill requests are zero
No search/scatter, 2D specialization, curvature, high-order FEM or pressure/porosity integration
